Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc')
# HDF5 file signature + version 0 superblock-like garbage unlikely valid, but we need bytes only.
# Start with HDF5 signature and minimal plausible structure may drive deeper parsing.
data = bytearray(b'\x89HDF\r\n\x1a\n')
# superblock version 0, offsets lengths etc with tiny dimensions and no extension; crafted mostly zeros
# bytes after signature: superblock version, freespace version, root group leaf/k, shared header, offsets sizes, file consistency flags
# then root group object header address. Keep short to force reads and malformed lengths.
data += bytes([0,0,0,0,0,0,8,8,0,0])
# root group object header address and other mandatory v0 fields, then pad a bit
# using small addresses/zeros
for _ in range(64):
    data += b'\x00'
p.write_bytes(data)
